served.front: header#front[data-reader-front] > h1 (title), subtitle, audience; optional a[data-route][data-route-chapters] from manifest routes
served.contents: nav#contents[data-reader-toc][aria-labelledby=contents-h]; li[data-part] > span#{part}-title; li > a[href=#{chapter}][data-chapter-link]; optional nested section links
served.section: section#{heading id}[data-section][aria-labelledby={heading id}-h] > h3#{heading id}-h (### nested with h4)
served.environment: div[data-env={definition|theorem|proposition|lemma|corollary|conditional|conjecture|heuristic|example|counterexample|construction|remark|notation|convention|open-problem|question|proof}][id] > [data-block-title] (numbered label line); optional dfn; [data-term] and [data-result] read as other names
served.equation: div.math-display#eq-… holding the formula and its number (never an empty marker)
served.figure: figure#{manifest id verbatim}[data-figure][data-qh-figure][data-figure-type] > figcaption (author's caption); optional [data-block-title]; owns its controls
served.reference: section#{id}[data-reference][aria-labelledby]: #glossary (dl > dt[id] + dd), #atlas[data-atlas-mount], and the old reference DOM kept whole with its old ids
served.cross_reference: a[href=#{id}] in running text opens a reminder; optional data-ref={kind}; data-ref=none keeps an ordinary link; links in nav navigate; links in [data-chapter-kicker] navigate
served.strict_hooks: a chapter is article[data-chapter] (not nested), a section is section[data-section]; components may carry data-chapter/data-section values
served.diagram: same hook as figures; node definition links a[href=#{section id}] open a reminder of that section; SVG text labels searched

created.notices: main > div.reader-notices[role=status] (first child, always present) > div.reader-notice[data-notice=resume|unknown] > p.reader-notice-text[tabindex=-1], p.reader-notice-actions > (a|button).reader-notice-action, button.reader-notice-close
created.results: .reader-group[data-group=best|{place id}] > p.reader-group-head > (.reader-group-where, .reader-group-title, .reader-group-count), ol.reader-hits > li.reader-hit > a.reader-hit-link > (.reader-hit-where, .reader-hit-title, .reader-hit-text > mark, .math-long, .reader-hit-formula), button.reader-group-more
created.theme: button#reader-theme.theme.reader-theme (only when the page serves no .theme): page label and icon; data-theme on the root and localStorage qh-theme; one switch per press

states.[data-current]: the shown place; the current chapter's li in the contents
states.[hidden=until-found]: every other place and the title page
states.a[aria-current=page|location]: current chapter link | section at the top of the screen
states.[data-revealed]: the element an address led to
states.::highlight(reader-find): search words in the place a result led to

from_reader.qh:state: {q, view, id} on document after every change of address

events.atlas_links: links inside [data-atlas-mount] are left to the atlas

open_points_for_root.R1: equation id on the display block, never an empty marker
open_points_for_root.R2: section[data-section] wrappers with h3#{id}-h (reader degrades to heading ids)
open_points_for_root.R3: data-env with the CHAPTER-MARKUP class; [data-block-title] on the numbered label line
open_points_for_root.R4: main[data-chapter-count] from the manifest while chapters arrive
open_points_for_root.R5: done: status.js reader mode; include status.js before reader.js
open_points_for_root.R6: C10 on the old tracker page is fixed by serving terms as links (proposal P5); monograph cross-references are inline links

qa_items.C12: notice markup above; styled in reader-css-proposal.css
qa_items.C17: chapters first in the book's order, reference last and collapsed to 3 with more
qa_items.C18: five bar controls at any width
qa_items.C1/C14: atlas hidden until found unless addressed
